title: One gained case and one lost case; 3/4 remains 3/4.
summary: Integrated retention completes the previously missed right bend but loses the left-bend success. Both chicanes complete. Separate replay admits all four cases, 45,632 attempted transitions and 3,530,538 scalar classifications across every registered branch.
boundary: The all-four hypothesis is contradicted. These are four exposed development cases, not independent scenes. Source comparison stays closed. Actual-history intervention, measured response delay and competitive advantage remain unestablished.
next: Audit timing feasibility of early registered endpoints across all four retained cases before changing the planner. Freeze the diagnostic population and test any proposed exclusion against retained successful transitions.
